source.title: Đáp án/transcript: TOEIC LR Collection 1 Test 2 - STUDY4

children.text: (A) Some notebooks are stacked on a desk.
(C) A lamp is covered with folders.
(D) Some pens are scattered across a desk.
(A) Shopping carts are being pushed through a store.
(B) Boxes are being stacked near an entrance.
(C) Groceries have been placed in a cart.
(D) Some shopping carts are lined up near an entrance.
(A) One of the men is holding a broom.
(B) One of the men is climbing a ladder.
(C) The men are carrying a board.
(D) The men are painting a wall.
(A) She's stacking some folders on a desk.
(B) She's refilling a printer with paper.
(C) Some folders have been dropped on the floor.
(D) A printer is positioned on a cabinet.
(A) A cabinet has been left open.
(B) Mugs have been placed on a counter.
(C) A coffee machine is being cleaned.
(D) Napkins have been stacked on a chair.
When can I pick up my dog after the operation?
(A) About one hundred and eighty dollars.
(B) Has the vet finished checking on her yet?
(C) In the recovery room at the back.
How many jars of the wildflower honey do you have left?
(A) Yes, the bees were very busy this year.
(C) Sure, I'll set some aside for you.
Who's presenting the traffic report this hour?
(B) Isn't it written on the schedule board?
(C) The report covers the highway closures.
How often do the tour boats leave the dock?
Why can't we stay open later on Fridays?
(B) The new display goes up Saturday.
(C) Because we're short on evening staff.
How do I sign up for the rewards card?
Has the irrigation system been repaired yet?
Who's driving the airport shuttle this evening?
When are the new laptops being handed out to everyone?
(C) No, I already knew about it.
The cough syrup's out of stock, isn't it?
(A) Everything's kept in the stockroom out back.
(B) It's for treating a sore throat.
(C) Yes, but we can have it in by tomorrow.
Who has the keys to the delivery van?
(A) The vases are in the back.
Do you know whether these cardboard boxes can be recycled here?
(A) You'd have to ask the attendant over there.
(B) The recycling bins are emptied every morning.
(C) Yes, I flattened them before I came.
What did you think of the new spin class?
(C) I thought it was pretty intense.
Is the crew going to finish clearing the fallen tree today, or will they have to come back another day?
(A) It's a pretty big oak, about forty feet tall.
(B) She's the supervisor for this job.
The Oakmont Gallery moved their exhibit opening up to Thursday.
(A) Okay, I'll let the framers know.
(B) The bottle opener is in the drawer.
(C) No, the movers haven't arrived yet.
One of the reading lamps at the corner study table keeps flickering.
(A) I'll grab a replacement bulb from the closet.
(B) The quicker way in is past the front desk.
(C) Your library card's just been renewed.
Why's the lobby fountain switched off this morning?
(A) No, I haven't found it anywhere.
(B) The maintenance crew is draining it to clean the filter.
(C) Yes, the water was really cold.
Would you mind checking whether my room's ready yet?
(A) Sure, I'll have your bags taken up.
(B) The system's been down all morning.
(C) It's a hundred and twenty a night.
Wasn't the guitar you tried out last month still for sale?
(B) No, I wasn't too tired that day.
(C) Actually, someone bought it on Saturday.
How do I book one of the private meeting rooms?
(B) They're listed in our member app.
Who do you think has the best chance of winning the cook-off this year?
(A) They're all doing a great job this year.
(B) I actually won it two years ago.
(C) Sorry, I'm too full to try any more.
Did Ms. Corrigan give you the delivery invoice?
(A) I thought she handed it to you.
Isn't the last ferry running tonight?
(B) The fare went up last week.
Who approved the change to the new bottle supplier?
(A) The plant manager did, I believe.
(B) Sometime late last month, I think.
(C) No, the new bottles are a little taller.
The vendor grinds the beans fresh before he opens up each morning, doesn't he?
(A) Well, his grinder's been out for repair all week.
